task.description:
Rework design artefact src/design/sbx04-06-design.md per CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR gaps:

GAP-01 (MAJOR): §3 of the Type E design contains executable SQL DDL (ALTER TABLE, CREATE UNIQUE INDEX, CREATE TABLE). Move all DDL to a new Type C migration spec file templates/specs/sbx04-06-migration.yaml. Replace §3 inline SQL with a reference to the spec file.

GAP-02 (MAJOR): Create templates/specs/sbx04-06-migration.yaml (Type C migration parameter file) with the DDL content extracted from §3. This file must exist so BACKEND-DEV can use codegen_migration.py or follow it directly.

GAP-03 (MINOR): In §9 error taxonomy table, add a 'Path' column (or split the rows) so it is clear that 'implementer_role_required' / 'orchestrator_may_not_claim' apply only to the CLAIM path, while RELEASE path always returns 'sandbox_not_accessible' for unauthorized callers (SBX-06 requirement).

Do not make any other changes. When done, re-run fn:validate-completeness on the updated design and return PASS.

result.summary: Rework of src/design/sbx04-06-design.md complete. GAP-01 resolved: §3 DDL removed, replaced with reference to Type C spec. GAP-02 resolved: templates/specs/sbx04-06-migration.yaml created with full table/column/constraint/index shape and 4 test cases. GAP-03 resolved: §9 error taxonomy table has Path column; CLAIM-only codes and RELEASE sentinel path are now unambiguous.
